about.heading: Meet the Director
about.name: Rana Tariq Anwar
bio: Rana Tariq Anwar brings over two decades of experience in international education and student recruitment across South Asia, the Middle East, and North America. As Director of Business Development for the Southampton Summer Programme, he is dedicated to connecting young learners with transformative study‑abroad experiences in the United Kingdom.

With a deep understanding of the cultural and academic aspirations of families in Pakistan, the UAE, and Canada, Tariq personally oversees every stage of the enrolment journey — from initial enquiry to airport pickup — ensuring a smooth, supportive experience for every student and parent.
highlights: Regional offices in Lahore, Dubai & Toronto
Personally guided 500+ students to UK programmes
Direct liaison with host families and school staff

location.heading: Welcome to Southampton
paragraphs: Southampton is a vibrant university city on the south coast of England (population ≈ 250 000). Famous for its maritime heritage—the Titanic sailed from here, and today the city is known as the 'cruise‑ship capital' of the UK. With two universities, a Premier League football team, over 50 parks, and a lively high‑street, Southampton offers a perfect blend of modernity and history.
The city is only 75 minutes by train from London and within easy reach of Oxford, Bath, the Isle of Wight, and many other English treasures.
highlights: Watermark – £85 m restaurant and entertainment hub

school.heading: Our School
school.description: Founded in 1976, our English language school welcomes students from more than 50 countries each year. We operate from four historic 18th‑century buildings centred around a tranquil garden.
features: Coffee room with snacks & drinks machine
Convenient city‑centre location (just minutes from shops & bus stops)

accommodation.heading: Homestay Accommodation
accommodation.description: All students stay with carefully selected host families in comfortable twin‑room homestays. Hosts provide a safe, welcoming environment and an authentic British lifestyle.
features: Weekly evening activities with other homestay students (Wednesdays, Fridays, Saturdays)
Support from a dedicated homestay coordinator

trips.heading: Weekly Trips & Activities
paragraphs: Our weekly schedule blends English lessons with themed excursions designed to deepen cultural understanding and boost confidence in speaking.
Activities range from treasure hunts and team challenges to music, drama, and sport. Every outing is preceded by classroom sessions that teach the relevant vocabulary, ensuring a richer experience.
items: 1 full‑day educational trip (e.g., museum, historic site)
1 half‑day trip (e.g., coastal walk, local market)
1 local visit each week (city park, community event)
Optional Sunday trip (extra fee) – explore nearby attractions
